Verifying Binary Integrity

Every official release is cryptographically hashed. You can verify your downloaded archive before extracting:

# Linux / macOS
sha256sum prady-v1.0.0-*.tar.gz

# Windows PowerShell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\\prady-v1.0.0-*.zip
